facts.text: The image is a creature reference sheet with one wide hero panel across the top, a row of three full-body turnaround panels in the middle, and a row of four close-up detail panels at the bottom.
The top hero panel shows a large charcoal-black dragon in a low quadrupedal stance facing left, with its neck extended, head lowered, and broad wings arched upward.

The dragon has long pale tan/bone-colored horns and cranial spikes, a row of dark spines along its neck and back, overlapping scales with subtle slate-blue highlights, four clawed limbs, and a long spiked tail.
The dragon's wings are large, dark, leathery, and bat-like, with visible elongated finger struts supporting the membrane.
The hero panel is set in a dark volcanic landscape with rocky ground, shallow reflective water, smoky haze, and glowing orange lava in the background.
The middle row contains three full-body views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and REAR, each showing the same dark dragon design with wings spread or partly extended.
The bottom row contains four close-up panels labeled HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.

The HEAD CLOSE panel shows the dragon's scaled face, pale horns, and an orange eye; the WING MEMBRANE panel shows a dark veined membrane; the CLAW AND FOOT panel shows a scaled foot with large pale claws; the SCALE DETAIL panel shows overlapping dark scales with blue iridescence.
Visible text labels beneath the panels read exactly: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
The overall palette is dominated by black and charcoal gray, with slate-blue scale highlights, bone/tan horns and claws, and warm orange lava accents.

Lighting is low-key and dramatic in the hero panel, with cool gray ambient light, warm orange glow from the lava, and specular highlights on the scales; the reference panels use a neutral dark background.

card.summary: Dark fantasy dragon character reference sheet showing a large charcoal-black, blue-sheened dragon with long pale horns, a spined back, clawed limbs, and broad bat-like wings, presented in a cinematic volcanic hero panel plus front, side, rear, and macro detail views.

attributes: charcoal-black overlapping scales with slate-blue iridescence
long pale tan and bone-colored horns and cranial spikes
row of dark spines along the neck, back, and tail
large leathery bat-like wings with elongated finger struts
four clawed limbs with large pale curved claws
pose: hero panel: low quadrupedal stance facing left, neck extended and head lowered, wings arched high
front panel: facing the viewer with wings spread symmetrically
side profile panel: standing in left-facing profile with wings partly extended
rear panel: facing away with wings spread
detail panels: close views of head, wing membrane, foot and claws, and scale texture

card.environment: Hero panel: dark volcanic rocky terrain with shallow reflective water, glowing orange lava, and smoky haze. Reference and detail panels: plain dark gray backgrounds.
card.lighting: Low-key dramatic lighting in the hero panel with cool gray ambient light, warm orange lava glow, and specular scale highlights; neutral dark studio-like lighting in the reference panels.
card.framing: Wide landscape hero panel above a three-panel turnaround row and a four-panel macro detail row.
card.style: Photorealistic dark fantasy creature concept art and cinematic visual development sheet.
card.camera: Mixed views: wide cinematic hero shot, centered full-body turnaround views, and macro detail crops.
card.characterisation: Menacing, ancient, heavily armored dark dragon with a predatory silhouette.

limitations: The image is a static reference sheet and cannot establish motion, sound, dialogue, or the dragon's real-world size.
Some fine texture detail in the smaller panels is limited by resolution, though the main forms and labels are legible.
